//! Produces and verifies a fictional native20 predecessor through unchanged public APIs.

use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use knx_core::commissioning::parameter_baseline::{
    BaselineEdit, ParameterBaseline, ParameterBaselines,
};
use knx_core::project::IdAllocators;
use knx_core::{
    Command, CommandStack, CommissioningState, CompletionStatus, DeviceId, DeviceInstance,
    Installation, InstallationId, Language, Project, SourceRef, Topology,
};
use knx_store::project_history::{
    self as history, JournalTrust, JournalWriteReport, NativeSnapshot,
};
use knx_store::{Connection, StoredOpaqueEntry};
use rusqlite::MAIN_DB;
use std::{fs, path::Path};

const FILE: &str = "native20-before-link-and-object-flags.sqlite";
const PROJECT: &str = "P-NATIVE20-SYNTHETIC";
const SOURCE: &str = "P-NATIVE20-SYNTHETIC/0.xml";
const PROGRAM: &str = "M-00FA_A-0001-01-0000";
const PRODUCT: &str = "M-00FA_H-0001_P-0001";
const PROGRAM_REF: &str = "M-00FA_H-0001_HP-0001";
const AT: &str = "2026-01-02T03:04:05.123456789Z";
const LABEL: &str = "Synthetic native20 saved root";
const OPAQUE: &[u8] = b"Synthetic retained payload\0\xff\x01\nnot manufacturer data";

fn project() -> Project {
    let mut project = Project::new(Language("en".into()));
    project.info.project_id = PROJECT.into();
    project.info.name = "Fictional native20 predecessor".into();
    project.info.project_number = Some("NATIVE20-FIXTURE".into());
    project.info.completion = CompletionStatus::FinishedDesign;
    project.installations.push(Installation {
        id: InstallationId(0),
        name: "Fictional installation".into(),
        default_line: None,
        multicast_address: None,
        completion: CompletionStatus::FinishedDesign,
        topology: Topology {
            areas: vec![],
            lines: vec![],
            unassigned: (1..=3).map(DeviceId).collect(),
        },
        buildings: vec![],
        group_ranges: vec![],
        group_addresses: vec![],
        parameters: vec![],
    });
    for id in 1..=3 {
        project.devices.insert(DeviceInstance {
            id: DeviceId(id),
            source: SourceRef {
                path: SOURCE.into(),
                ets_id: format!("{PROJECT}-0_DI-{id}"),
            },
            name: format!("Fictional device {id}"),
            description: None,
            address: None,
            product_ref: PRODUCT.into(),
            program_ref: PROGRAM_REF.into(),
            commissioning: CommissioningState::default(),
            visibility_calculated: true,
            com_objects: vec![],
            binary_data: vec![],
        });
    }
    project.ids = IdAllocators::from_counts(3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    project
}

fn baselines() -> ParameterBaselines {
    let at = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(AT)
        .unwrap()
        .with_timezone(&Utc);
    [
        (
            DeviceId(1),
            ParameterBaseline {
                program_id: PROGRAM.into(),
                values: [
                    (format!("{PROGRAM}_P-1_R-1"), "01".into()),
                    (format!("{PROGRAM}_P-2_R-2"), String::new()),
                    (
                        format!("{PROGRAM}_P-3_R-3"),
                        "Text; \"quoted\" ß\nnext line".into(),
                    ),
                ]
                .into_iter()
                .collect(),
                at,
            },
        ),
        (
            DeviceId(2),
            ParameterBaseline {
                program_id: PROGRAM.into(),
                values: Default::default(),
                at,
            },
        ),
    ]
    .into_iter()
    .collect()
}

fn opaque() -> Vec<StoredOpaqueEntry> {
    vec![StoredOpaqueEntry {
        source_path: "P-NATIVE20-SYNTHETIC/evidence.bin".into(),
        xpath: "/Synthetic/Device[@Id='P-NATIVE20-SYNTHETIC-0_DI-1']".into(),
        kind: "ContainerEntry".into(),
        name: "fictional-retained-control".into(),
        bytes: OPAQUE.to_vec(),
        sha256: history::image_hash(OPAQUE),
    }]
}

fn model(project: &Project) -> NativeSnapshot {
    NativeSnapshot {
        project: project.clone(),
        opaque: vec![],
        manufacturer_refs: vec![],
    }
}

fn complete(project: &Project) -> NativeSnapshot {
    NativeSnapshot {
        project: project.clone(),
        opaque: opaque(),
        manufacturer_refs: vec![],
    }
}

fn preserved(snapshot: &NativeSnapshot, with_opaque: bool) {
    let project = &snapshot.project;
    assert_eq!(project.schema_version, 20);
    assert_eq!(project.info.project_id, PROJECT);
    assert_eq!(project.devices.iter().count(), 3);
    assert_eq!(project.ids.peek_device(), 3);
    assert_eq!(project.installations.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(
        project.installations[0].topology.unassigned,
        vec![DeviceId(1), DeviceId(2), DeviceId(3)]
    );
    for id in 1..=3 {
        let device = project.devices.get(DeviceId(id)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(device.id, DeviceId(id));
        assert_eq!(device.source.path, SOURCE);
        assert_eq!(device.source.ets_id, format!("{PROJECT}-0_DI-{id}"));
        assert_eq!(device.product_ref, PRODUCT);
        assert_eq!(device.program_ref, PROGRAM_REF);
    }
    assert_eq!(snapshot.opaque, if with_opaque { opaque() } else { vec![] });
    for entry in &snapshot.opaque {
        assert_eq!(entry.bytes, OPAQUE);
        assert_eq!(entry.sha256, history::image_hash(&entry.bytes));
    }
    assert!(snapshot.manufacturer_refs.is_empty());
}

fn schema(conn: &Connection) {
    assert_eq!(knx_core::project::CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, 20);
    assert_eq!(knx_store::CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, 20);
    let version: i64 = conn
        .query_row("PRAGMA user_version", [], |r| r.get(0))
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(version, 20);
    let columns = conn
        .prepare("PRAGMA table_info(device_parameter_baseline)")
        .unwrap()
        .query_map([], |r| r.get::<_, String>(1))
        .unwrap()
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(columns, vec!["device_id", "program_id", "at"]);
    let tables = conn
        .prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='table' AND (name GLOB 'device_*baseline*') ORDER BY name")
        .unwrap()
        .query_map([], |r| r.get::<_, String>(0))
        .unwrap()
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        tables,
        vec![
            "device_parameter_baseline",
            "device_parameter_baseline_value"
        ]
    );
    let integrity: String = conn
        .query_row("PRAGMA integrity_check", [], |r| r.get(0))
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(integrity, "ok");
    assert!(!conn
        .prepare("PRAGMA foreign_key_check")
        .unwrap()
        .exists([])
        .unwrap());
}

fn baseline_rows(conn: &Connection, expected: &ParameterBaselines) {
    let all = history::load_parameter_baselines(conn).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(&all, expected);
    assert_eq!(all.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(all.get(DeviceId(1)).unwrap().values.len(), 3);
    assert!(
        all.get(DeviceId(2)).unwrap().values.is_empty(),
        "recorded empty header"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        all.get(DeviceId(3)),
        None,
        "present device with no baseline is unknown"
    );
    let headers = conn
        .prepare(
            "SELECT device_id, program_id, at FROM device_parameter_baseline ORDER BY device_id",
        )
        .unwrap()
        .query_map([], |r| {
            Ok((
                r.get::<_, u32>(0)?,
                r.get::<_, String>(1)?,
                r.get::<_, String>(2)?,
            ))
        })
        .unwrap()
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        headers,
        vec![
            (1, PROGRAM.into(), AT.into()),
            (2, PROGRAM.into(), AT.into())
        ]
    );
    let values = conn
        .prepare("SELECT device_id, ref_id, raw FROM device_parameter_baseline_value ORDER BY device_id, ref_id")
        .unwrap()
        .query_map([], |r| Ok((r.get::<_, u32>(0)?, r.get::<_, String>(1)?, r.get::<_, String>(2)?)))
        .unwrap()
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
        .unwrap();
    let expected_values: Vec<_> = expected
        .iter()
        .flat_map(|(id, b)| {
            b.values
                .iter()
                .map(move |(key, raw)| (id.0, key.clone(), raw.clone()))
        })
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(values, expected_values);
}

fn image_without_baselines(bytes: &[u8]) {
    // This small fixture uses the codec's raw-SQLite lane, not compressed images.
    assert!(bytes.starts_with(b"SQLite format 3\0"));
    let mut conn = Connection::open_in_memory().unwrap();
    conn.deserialize_read_exact(MAIN_DB, bytes, bytes.len(), true)
        .unwrap();
    schema(&conn);
    for table in [
        "device_parameter_baseline",
        "device_parameter_baseline_value",
    ] {
        let count: i64 = conn
            .query_row(&format!("SELECT count(*) FROM {table}"), [], |r| r.get(0))
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(count, 0, "file-level rows must not enter history images");
    }
    let decoded = NativeSnapshot::decode(bytes, &history::image_hash(bytes)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(decoded.project.schema_version, 20);
}

fn capture_image(out: &Path, name: &str, snapshot: &NativeSnapshot) {
    let bytes = snapshot.encode().unwrap();
    let hash = history::image_hash(&bytes);
    assert_eq!(NativeSnapshot::decode(&bytes, &hash).unwrap(), *snapshot);
    assert!(NativeSnapshot::decode(&bytes, &"0".repeat(64)).is_err());
    image_without_baselines(&bytes);
    fs::write(out.join(format!("{name}.image")), &bytes).unwrap();
    fs::write(
        out.join(format!("{name}.semantic-sha256")),
        snapshot.semantic_hash().unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    fs::write(
        out.join(format!("{name}.debug")),
        format!("{snapshot:#?}\n"),
    )
    .unwrap();
}

fn stored_images(conn: &Connection) -> Vec<(String, Vec<u8>, String)> {
    conn.prepare(
        "SELECT 'stored-working', working, working_hash FROM project_history_state
         UNION ALL SELECT 'stored-' || side || '-' || position, image, image_hash FROM project_history_stack
         UNION ALL SELECT 'stored-named-' || id, image, image_hash FROM project_history_version
         UNION ALL SELECT 'stored-context', image, image_hash FROM project_history_context ORDER BY 1",
    ).unwrap().query_map([], |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?, r.get(2)?)))
        .unwrap().collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>().unwrap()
}

fn verify_reopen(
    path: &Path,
    root: &NativeSnapshot,
    working: &NativeSnapshot,
    undo: &[Project],
    redo: &[Project],
    generation: i64,
    named: i64,
) {
    let before = fs::read(path).unwrap();
    let store = knx_store::open_existing_read_only(path).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(store.migrated_from, None);
    schema(&store.conn);
    baseline_rows(&store.conn, &baselines());
    assert_eq!(NativeSnapshot::read(&store.conn).unwrap(), *root);
    let recovered = history::load_editor(&store.conn).unwrap().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(recovered.generation, generation);
    assert_eq!(recovered.baseline, *root);
    assert_eq!(recovered.working, *working);
    assert_eq!(recovered.undo, undo);
    assert_eq!(recovered.redo, redo);
    assert_eq!((recovered.undo.len(), recovered.redo.len()), (2, 1));
    let versions = history::list_versions(&store.conn).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(versions.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(versions[0].label, LABEL);
    assert_eq!(versions[0].reason, "named");
    assert_eq!(versions[0].id, named);
    assert_eq!(history::read_version(&store.conn, named).unwrap(), *root);
    preserved(&recovered.baseline, true);
    preserved(&recovered.working, true);
    let mut project = recovered.working.project.clone();
    let mut stack = CommandStack::from_snapshot_states(recovered.undo, recovered.redo);
    stack.undo(&mut project).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(project, undo[1]);
    preserved(&complete(&project), true);
    stack.undo(&mut project).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(project, root.project);
    stack.redo(&mut project).unwrap();
    stack.redo(&mut project).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(project, working.project);
    stack.redo(&mut project).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(project, redo[0]);
    preserved(&complete(&project), true);
    baseline_rows(&store.conn, &baselines());
    for (_, bytes, hash) in stored_images(&store.conn) {
        assert_eq!(history::image_hash(&bytes), hash);
        image_without_baselines(&bytes);
    }
    assert!(store
        .conn
        .execute("DELETE FROM project_history_state", [])
        .is_err());
    store.conn.close().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read(path).unwrap(),
        before,
        "read-only reopen changed file bytes"
    );
    for suffix in ["-wal", "-shm", "-journal"] {
        assert!(!path.with_file_name(format!("{FILE}{suffix}")).exists());
    }
}

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<_> = std::env::args().collect();
    assert_eq!(args.len(), 2, "producer NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY");
    let out = Path::new(&args[1]);
    fs::create_dir(out).expect("new attempt directory required; retain failed attempts");
    let root = complete(&project());
    preserved(&root, true);
    let path = out.join(FILE);
    let conn = knx_store::open_and_migrate(&path).unwrap();
    schema(&conn);
    let generation = history::save_editor(&conn, &root, &CommandStack::new(), None, true).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(NativeSnapshot::read(&conn).unwrap(), root);
    assert!(history::load_parameter_baselines(&conn).unwrap().is_empty());
    let generation = history::create_version(&conn, &root, LABEL, generation).unwrap();
    let named = history::list_versions(&conn).unwrap()[0].id;
    let mut working = root.clone();
    let mut stack = CommandStack::new();
    stack
        .do_command(
            &mut working.project,
            Command::RenameDevice {
                device: DeviceId(1),
                name: "Fictional dirty working name".into(),
            },
        )
        .unwrap();
    stack
        .do_command(
            &mut working.project,
            Command::SetDeviceDescription {
                device: DeviceId(2),
                description: Some("Fictional working description; ß".into()),
            },
        )
        .unwrap();
    stack
        .do_command(
            &mut working.project,
            Command::RenameDevice {
                device: DeviceId(3),
                name: "Fictional redo-only name".into(),
            },
        )
        .unwrap();
    stack.undo(&mut working.project).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(stack.history_lengths(), (2, 1));
    let (undo, redo) = stack.snapshot_states(&working.project).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(undo[0], root.project);
    assert_ne!(working, root);
    for p in undo.iter().chain(redo.iter()).chain([&working.project]) {
        preserved(&complete(p), true);
    }
    let generation =
        history::save_editor(&conn, &working, &stack, Some(generation), false).unwrap();
    let images_before = stored_images(&conn);
    let expected = baselines();
    let edits: Vec<_> = expected
        .iter()
        .map(|(device, b)| BaselineEdit {
            device,
            baseline: Some(b.clone()),
        })
        .collect();
    let (generation, _) = history::save_editor_settling(
        &conn,
        &working,
        &stack,
        generation,
        &JournalTrust::default(),
        &mut JournalWriteReport::default(),
        &edits,
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        stored_images(&conn),
        images_before,
        "settlement changes no history image bytes"
    );
    baseline_rows(&conn, &expected);
    assert_eq!(NativeSnapshot::read(&conn).unwrap(), root);
    schema(&conn);
    capture_image(out, "root-complete", &root);
    capture_image(out, "root-model", &model(&root.project));
    capture_image(out, "working-complete", &working);
    capture_image(out, "working-model", &model(&working.project));
    let named_snapshot = history::read_version(&conn, named).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(named_snapshot, root);
    capture_image(out, "named-complete", &named_snapshot);
    capture_image(out, "named-model", &model(&named_snapshot.project));
    for (side, projects) in [("undo", &undo), ("redo", &redo)] {
        for (i, p) in projects.iter().enumerate() {
            capture_image(out, &format!("{side}-{i}-model"), &model(p));
            capture_image(out, &format!("{side}-{i}-complete"), &complete(p));
        }
    }
    for (name, bytes, hash) in stored_images(&conn) {
        assert_eq!(history::image_hash(&bytes), hash);
        image_without_baselines(&bytes);
        let snapshot = NativeSnapshot::decode(&bytes, &hash).unwrap();
        fs::write(out.join(format!("{name}.image")), &bytes).unwrap();
        fs::write(
            out.join(format!("{name}.semantic-sha256")),
            snapshot.semantic_hash().unwrap(),
        )
        .unwrap();
    }
    fs::write(out.join("generation.txt"), generation.to_string()).unwrap();
    fs::write(out.join("baselines.debug"), format!("{expected:#?}\n")).unwrap();
    conn.close().unwrap();
    verify_reopen(&path, &root, &working, &undo, &redo, generation, named);
    verify_reopen(&path, &root, &working, &undo, &redo, generation, named);
    let result = "PASS: genuine schema20; devices=3; exact stable identities/allocators/topology; parameter headers=2 values=3 (one empty raw); recorded empty device2 distinct from absent device3; fractional UTC time exact; saved root differs from working; undo=2 redo=1 named=1; settlement leaves all history image bytes unchanged; all snapshot baseline tables empty; exact Project/opaque equality; recovered undo/redo replay; integrity_check=ok foreign_key_check=empty; read-only native reopen twice, no migration, no changed bytes or sidecars; bad image hash refused\n";
    fs::write(out.join("producer-result.txt"), result).unwrap();
    print!("{result}");
    println!(
        "history format={} generation={generation} named_id={named}",
        history::FORMAT_VERSION
    );
}
